claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Keeppower IMR26650 5200mAh 30A as a 5200mAh preset with a 30A runtime rating.
The tested black 2014 Keeppower IMR26650 5200mAh revision is flat-top and unprotected, with observed dimensions of approximately 26.5 mm x 67.0 mm; the nominal catalog size remains 26650.

The Keeppower IMR26650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Keeppower IMR26650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2014-06-23 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: The black 2014 unprotected flat-top revision is well documented, but Keeppower sells multiple 5200mAh 26650 constructions and exact sample identity still needs matching.
checks: Match the black unprotected wrapper and terminal before applying the observed 67 mm length.
Check for a protection circuit and compare the label/markings with a known-good Keeppower sample.
Do not infer the construction from capacity and brand alone.
